Scope This Regulation applies to filament light sources and their LED replacement light sources shown in Annex 1 and intended for use in approved lamps of power-driven vehicles and of their trailers.

title: Administrative provisions
text: Administrative provisions

heading: Administrative provisions
text: Definitions The definitions given in Resolution R.E.5 or its subsequent revisions, applicable at the time of application for type approval shall apply.

heading: Administrative provisions
text: Definition of " _category_ " The term "category" is used in this Regulation to describe different basic design of standardised filament light sources, producing light by incandescent technology, and to describe different basic design of standardised LED replacement light sources, producing light by LED technology. Each category has a specific designation, as for example: "H4", "P21W", "T4W", "PY21W"or "RR10W"; however, a LED replacement light source category has the same designation1 as its counterpart filament light source category, as for example "H11. 1 A LED replacement light source category has the same designation, as it is designed to replace its counterpart filament light source category with equivalent performance; however, it is a distinct category due to another light producing technology being used, described in a separate light source category data sheet shown in Annex 1.

heading: Administrative provisions
title: Definition of " _type_ "
text: Definition of " _type_ "

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: Filament light sources of different2 "types" are filament light sources within the same filament light source category which differ in such essential respects as: 2A selective-yellow bulb or an additional selective-yellow outer bulb, solely intended to change the colour but not the other characteristics of a filament light source emitting white light, does not constitute a change of type of the filament light source.

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: Trade name or mark; Filament light sources bearing the same trade name or mark but produced by different manufacturers are considered as being of different types. Filament light sources produced by the same manufacturer differing only by the trade name or mark may be considered to be of the same type;

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: Bulb design and/or cap design, in so far as these differences affect the optical results;

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: Rated voltage;

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: Halogen.

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: LED replacement light sources of different3 "types" are LED replacement light sources within the same LED replacement light source category which differ in such essential respects as: 3An optional AE device for the LED replacement light source does not constitute a change of type of the LED replacement light source.

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: Trade name or mark; LED replacement light sources bearing the same trade name or mark but produced by different manufacturers are considered as being of different types. LED replacement light sources produced by the same manufacturer differing only by the trade name or mark may be considered to be of the same type;

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: Light source design, in so far as these differences affect the optical results;

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: Rated voltage;

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: High-efficiency;

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: Particular electrical polarity;

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: Oversize cap.

heading: Administrative provisions > Definition of " _type_ "
text: LED replacement light sources and their counterpart filament light sources are considered as being of different types.

heading: Administrative provisions
title: Application for approval
text: Application for approval

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: Application for approval shall be submitted by the owner of the trade name or mark, or by his duly accredited representative.

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: Every application for approval shall be accompanied (see also paragraph 2.4.2.) by:

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: Drawings in triplicate, sufficiently detailed to permit identification of the light producing technology and of the type;

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: A brief technical description, which:

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: In the case of a filament light source, shall include the shape of the filament if the relevant light source sheet specifies that a straight or V-shaped filament is allowed;

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: In the case of a LED replacement light source, shall include a statement whether the following conditions apply to LED replacement light source: (a) It is a high-efficiency LED replacement light source, (b) An AE device (Additional Electronics device as defined in R.E.5) is included for applications listed according to paragraph 4.2.2.1.2., (c) I has a particular electrical polarity, (d) It is equipped with an oversize cap;

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: In the case of a high-efficiency LED replacement light source, shall include the range of the electrical current at test voltage; this range shall be below the objective minimum value of the electrical current as specified in the data sheet of Annex 1, which does not apply to the high-efficiency LED replacement light source without or with disconnected AE device;

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: In the case of AE device(s) is/are included, shall include trade name(s) or mark(s) of the AE device(s), the rated voltage, the maximum wattage and the specific identification code(s), if already granted to other LED replacement light source(s) together with this/these AE device(s).

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: Five samples of each colour which has been applied for;

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: Five samples of AE device(s) if prescribed by the applicant according to paragraph 2.2.2.2.2;

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: Documents, in the case of LED replacement light sources, showing:

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: The information to be displayed on the packaging of LED replacement light sources;

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: The instructions to be contained by the packaging of LED replacement light sources if at least one of the conditions in paragraph 2.2.2.2.2. applies; an initial listing as described in paragraph 4.2.2.1 shall be included.

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: In the case of a type of light source, or AE device suitable to a type of LED replacement light source, differing only by the trade name or mark from a type of light source, or AE device suitable to a type of LED replacement light source, that has already been approved it shall be sufficient to submit:

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: A declaration by the manufacturer that the type submitted is identical (except in the trade name or mark) and has been produced by the same manufacturer as, the type already approved, the latter being identified by its approval code;

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: Two samples bearing the new trade name or mark.

heading: Administrative provisions > Application for approval
text: The Type Approval Authority shall verify the existence of satisfactory arrangements for ensuring effective control of the conformity of production before type approval is granted.

heading: Administrative provisions
title: Inscriptions
text: Inscriptions

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: Light sources submitted for approval shall bear:4 4The luminous characteristics shall not be adversely affected.

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: The trade name or mark of the applicant;

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: The rated voltage. However, for light sources for which only a 12 V type is standardised and the maximum allowed bulb diameter of which does not exceed 7.5 mm, the rated voltage need not be marked;

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: The designation of the relevant category. The wattage character "W" of this designation need not be marked if the maximum allowed bulb diameter of the light source type does not exceed 7.5 mm;

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: The rated wattage in the case of a filament light source, (in the sequence, high wattage/low wattage filament for dual-filament light sources); this need not be indicated separately if it is part of the designation of the relevant filament light source category;

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: The character "ͰE"5 in the case of a high-efficiency LED replacement light source; this mark shall be placed before the truncated circle according to paragraph 2.4.3.1., separated by a single character space. 5This character can be composed of "H" overlapping with "E" or of "Ͱ" (Unicode 0370 Hex) connected to "E" (Unicode 0045 Hex).

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: A space of sufficient size to accommodate the approval mark;

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: In the case of a LED replacement light sources for which at least one of the conditions in paragraph 2.2.2.2.2. applies, the following symbol:6 6ISO 7000, symbol 1641

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: The space mentioned in paragraph 2.3.1.6. above shall be indicated in the drawings accompanying the application for approval.

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: Halogen filament light sources meeting the requirements of paragraph 3.3.4. below shall be marked with a "U".

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: LED replacement light sources shall be marked with "LEDr".

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: The AE device(s) or the cable(s) permanently fixed to the AE device(s), if any, shall bear:

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: The trade name or mark of the applicant;

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: The rated voltage and maximum wattage;

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: The specific identification code(s), or if it concerns a new application, a space sufficient to accommodate the specific identification code.

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: The specific identification code of an AE device shall comprise the starting character "Æ"7 for "ADDITIONAL ELECTRONICS", followed by the distinguishing number of the country of the approval authority and, separated by a single character space, the approval code of the LED replacement light source, with which the additional electronics device(s) has/have been approved. Annex 3 to this Regulation gives an example of arrangement of a specific identification code. 7Unicode 00C6 Hex

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: An AE device may bear more than one specific identification code together with the belonging trade name or mark if all are from the same applicant.

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: LED replacement light sources with a particular electrical polarity that operate in only one position while by design the LED replacement light source or its electrical connector can be inserted in more than one position, shall be marked with the electrical polarity, which is to be connected to the respective terminals of the light source, using the symbols "+" or "―" according to the electrical polarity specification given in the relevant light source category data sheet, placed closely to or on the respective terminal.

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: LED replacement light sources with an oversize cap, of which geometric dimensions of the cap, not relevant for interchangeability, exceed those specified in the relevant cap data sheet of IEC Publication 60061, but which are within maximum allowed deviations as specified in the relevant light source category data sheet, shall be marked with the following symbol,8 followed by the exclamation mark, separated by a single character space, as follows: 8ISO 7000, symbol 919

heading: Administrative provisions > Inscriptions
text: Inscriptions other than those covered by paragraphs 2.3.1. and 2.4.3. may be affixed, on the condition that they do not adversely affect the luminous characteristics.

heading: Administrative provisions
title: Approval
text: Approval

heading: Administrative provisions > Approval
text: If all samples of a type of light source which are submitted in pursuance of paragraphs 2.2.2.3. or 2.2.3.2. above meet the requirements of this Regulation, whereby for LED replacement light sources also the provision in paragraph 3.4.7.1. applies, approval shall be granted.

heading: Administrative provisions > Approval
text: An approval code shall be assigned to each type approved. This approval code shall consist of Section 3 of the approval number.9 The same Contracting Party may not assign the same code to another type of light source Notice of approval or of extension or refusal or withdrawal of approval or production definitively discontinued of a type of light source pursuant to this Regulation shall be communicated to the Parties of the Agreement which apply this Regulation by means of a form conforming to the model in Annex 2 to this Regulation and of a drawing, supplied by the applicant for approval in a format not exceeding A4 (210 x 297 mm) and on a scale of at least 2:1. If the applicant so desires, the same approval number (and the same correlating approval code) may be assigned to the filament light source emitting white light and to the filament light source emitting selective-yellow light (see paragraph 2.1.2., footnote 2). 91958 Agreement, Revision 3, Schedule 4 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3).

heading: Administrative provisions > Approval
text: To every light source conforming to a type approved under this Regulation there shall be affixed in the space referred to in paragraph 2.3.1.6., in addition to the inscriptions required under paragraph 2.3.1., an approval mark consisting of:

heading: Administrative provisions > Approval
text: A truncated circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.10 10The distinguish numbers of the Contracting Parties to the 1958 Agreement are reproduced in Annex 3 to Consolidated Resolution on the Construction of Vehicles (R.E.3) (ECE/TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.6).

heading: Administrative provisions > Approval
text: The approval code, placed close to the truncated circle.

heading: Administrative provisions > Approval
text: If the applicant has obtained the same approval number (and the same correlating approval code for several trade names or marks, one or more of them will suffice to meet the requirements of paragraph 2.3.1.1.

heading: Administrative provisions > Approval
text: The marks and inscriptions specified in paragraphs 2.3.1. 2.3.5., 2.3.8., 2.3.9. and 2.4.3. shall be clearly legible and be indelible.

heading: Administrative provisions > Approval
text: Annex 3 to this Regulation gives examples of arrangement of the approval mark and specific identification code.

title: Technical requirements
text: Technical requirements

heading: Technical requirements
text: Definitions The definitions given in Resolution [R.E.4]5 or its subsequent revisions, applicable at the time of application for type approval shall apply. 5Note by the secretariat: Draft Resolution on the common specification of light source categories (R.E.4) is submitted to WP.29 as document ECE/TRANS/WP.29/2016/111.

heading: Technical requirements
title: General specifications
text: General specifications

heading: Technical requirements > General specifications
text: Each sample submitted shall conform to the relevant specifications of this Regulation.

heading: Technical requirements > General specifications
text: Light sources shall be so designed as to be and to remain in good working order when in normal use. They shall moreover exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.

heading: Technical requirements > General specifications
text: The filament(s) shall be the only element(s) of the filament light source that generate and emit light when energized. The solid-state junction(s) and possibly one or more elements for fluorescence-based conversion shall be the only element(s) of the LED replacement light source that generate(s) and emit(s) light when energized.

heading: Technical requirements > General specifications
text: Light sources shall exhibit no scores or spots which might impair their efficiency and their optical performance. This shall be verified for LED replacement light sources when commencing approval testing and when required in the respective paragraphs in this Regulation.

heading: Technical requirements > General specifications
text: Light sources shall be equipped with standard caps complying with the cap data sheets of IEC Publication 60061, as specified on the individual data sheets of Annex 1.

heading: Technical requirements > General specifications
text: LED replacement light sources shall be equipped with a cap of the same cap designation as specified for its counterpart filament light sources with the same category designation.

heading: Technical requirements > General specifications
text: Geometric dimensions of the cap of the LED replacement light source, not relevant for interchangeability, may deviate from those specified in the relevant cap data sheet of IEC Publication 60061 within maximum allowed values if these maximum deviations are specified in the relevant light source category data sheet (oversize cap).

heading: Technical requirements > General specifications
text: The cap shall be strong and firmly secured to the bulb of the filament light source.

heading: Technical requirements > General specifications
text: To ascertain whether light sources conform to the requirements of paragraphs 3.2.4. to 3.2.6. above, a visual inspection, a dimension check and, where necessary, a trial fitting into the holder as specified in IEC publication 60061 shall be carried out.

heading: Technical requirements
title: Filament light sources (incandescent technology)
text: Filament light sources (incandescent technology)

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology)
title: Tests
text: Tests

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Tests
text: Filament light sources shall first be aged at their test voltage for approximately one hour. For dualfilament light sources, each filament shall be aged separately. In the case of filament light sources, for which more than one test voltage is specified, the highest test voltage value shall be used for ageing.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Tests
text: In the case of a filament light source having a coated bulb, after the ageing period corresponding to paragraph 3.4.1., the surface of the bulb shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol. After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually. It shall not show any apparent changes.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Tests
text: The position and dimensions of the filament shall be measured with the filament light sources being supplied with current at from 90 per cent to 100 per cent of the test voltage. In the case of filament light sources, for which more than one test voltage is specified, the highest test voltage value shall be used for measurement of the position and dimensions of the filament.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Tests
text: Unless otherwise specified, electrical and photometric measurements shall be carried out at the test voltage(s).

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Tests
text: Electrical measurements shall be carried out with instruments of at least class 0.2.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Tests
text: In the case where the selective-yellow colour is allowed, the luminous flux of the filament light source with the selective-yellow outer bulb shall be at least 85 per cent of the specified luminous flux of the relevant filament light source emitting white light.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology)
title: Filament position and dimensions
text: Filament position and dimensions

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Filament position and dimensions
text: The geometric shapes of the filament shall in principle be as specified on the filament light source data sheets of Annex 1.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Filament position and dimensions
text: For line filaments the correct position and shape shall be checked as specified in the relevant data sheets.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Filament position and dimensions
text: If the filament is shown on the filament light source data sheet in at least one view as a point, the position of the luminous centre shall be determined in conformity with Annex 4.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Filament position and dimensions
text: The length of a line filament shall be determined by its ends, defined - unless otherwise specified on the relevant data sheet - as the apices of the first and the last filament turn as seen in projection perpendicular to the reference axis of the filament light source. Such an apex shall comply with the requirement that the angle formed by the legs shall not exceed 90°. In the case of coiled-coil filaments the apices of the secondary turns shall be taken into account. Apices outside the point of connection to the current lead-in legs shall be disregarded for the determination of the filament length.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Filament position and dimensions
text: For axial filaments the extreme position of the apices considered shall be determined by rotating the filament light source about its reference axis. The length shall then be measured in a direction parallel to the reference axis.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Filament position and dimensions
text: For transverse filaments the filament axis shall be placed perpendicular to the direction of projection. The length shall be measured in a direction perpendicular to the reference axis.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology)
title: Colour
text: Colour

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: The colour of the light emitted by the filament light source shall be white unless otherwise specified on the relevant data sheet.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: The definitions of the colour of the light emitted, given in Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for type approval, shall apply to this Regulation.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured by the method specified in Annex 5. Each measured value shall lie within the required chromaticity area.11 Moreover, in the case of filament light sources emitting white light, the measured values shall not deviate more than 0.020 unit in the x and/or y direction from a point of choice on the Planckian locus (CIE 015 :2018, 4th edition). Filament light sources for use in light signalling devices shall meet the requirements as specified in paragraph 4.4.2. of IEC Publication 60809, Edition 3. 11For conformity of production purposes of amber and red colour only, at least 80 per cent of the measuring results shall lie within the required chromaticity area.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology)
text: Observation concerning selective-yellow colour An approval of a filament light source type under this Regulation may be granted, pursuant to paragraph 3.6. above, for a filament light source emitting white light as well as selective-yellow light; Article 3 of the Agreement to which this Regulation is annexed shall not prevent the Contracting Parties from prohibiting, on vehicles registered by them, filament light sources emitting either white or selective-yellow light.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology)
text: Check on optical quality (Applies only to filament light sources with an internal shield to produce the cut-off).

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: This check on optical quality shall be carried out at a voltage such that the measuring luminous flux is obtained; the specifications of paragraph 3.4.6. are to be observed accordingly.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: For 12-volt filament light sources emitting white light: The sample which most nearly conforms to the requirements laid down for the standard filament light source shall be tested in a standard headlamp as specified in paragraph 3.9.5. and it shall be verified whether the assembly comprising the aforesaid headlamp and the filament light source being tested meets the light-distribution requirements laid down for the passing beam in the relevant Regulation.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: For 6-volt and 24-volt filament light sources emitting white light: The sample which most nearly conforms to the nominal dimension values shall be tested in a standard headlamp as specified in paragraph 3.9.5. and it shall be verified whether the assembly comprising the aforesaid headlamp and the filament light source being tested meets the light-distribution requirements laid down for the passing beam in the relevant Regulation. Deviations not exceeding 10 per cent of the minimum values will be acceptable.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: Filament light sources emitting selective-yellow light shall be tested in the same manner as described in paragraphs 3.9.2. and 3.9.3. in a standard headlamp as specified in paragraph 3.9.5. to ensure that the illumination complies with at least 85 per cent for 12-volt filament light sources, and at least 77 per cent for 6-volt and 24-volt filament light sources, with the minimum values of the light-distribution requirements laid down for the passing beam in the relevant Regulation. The maximum illumination limits remain unchanged. In the case of a filament light source having a selective-yellow bulb, this test shall be left out if the approval is also given to the same type of filament light source emitting white light.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: A headlamp shall be deemed to be a standard headlamp if:

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: It satisfies the pertinent conditions of approval;

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: It has an effective diameter of not less than 160 mm;

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: With a standard filament light source it produces at the various points and in the various zones specified for the headlamp type concerned, illumination equal to:

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: Not more than 90 per cent of the maximum limits;

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology) > Colour
text: Not less than 120 per cent of the minimum limits prescribed for the headlamp type concerned.

heading: Technical requirements > Filament light sources (incandescent technology)
text: Standard filament light sources Additional requirements for standard (étalon) filament light sources are given on the relevant data sheets of Annex 1. Bulbs of standard (étalon) filament light sources emitting white light shall not alter the CIE trichromatic coordinates of a luminous source having a colour temperature of 2,856 K by more than 0.010 units in the x and/or y direction. For standard (étalon) filament light sources emitting amber or red light, changes of the bulb temperature shall not affect the luminous flux which might impair photometric measurements of signalling devices.

heading: Technical requirements
title: LED replacement light sources (LED technology)
text: LED replacement light sources (LED technology)

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology)
title: Tests
text: Tests

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Tests
text: LED replacement light sources shall first be aged at their test voltage for at least forty-eight hours. For LED replacement light sources with the counterpart being a dual filament light sources, each function shall be aged separately.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Tests
text: Unless otherwise specified, electrical and photometric measurements shall be carried out at the relevant test voltage(s).

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Tests
text: Electrical measurements as specified in Annex 6 shall be carried out with instruments of at least class 0.2 (0.2 per cent full scale accuracy).

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology)
title: Position and dimensions of light emitting area
text: Position and dimensions of light emitting area

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Position and dimensions of light emitting area
text: The position and dimensions of the light emitting area shall conform to the requirements as given on the relevant data sheet of Annex 1.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Position and dimensions of light emitting area
text: The measurement shall be made after ageing the LED replacement light source according to paragraph 3.4.1.1.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology)
title: Luminous flux
text: Luminous flux

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Luminous flux
text: When measured according to the conditions specified in Annex 6, the luminous flux shall be within the limits given on the relevant data sheet of Annex 1.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Luminous flux
text: The measurement shall be made after ageing the LED replacement light source according to 3.4.1.1.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology)
title: Normalized luminous intensity distribution / cumulative luminous flux distribution
text: Normalized luminous intensity distribution / cumulative luminous flux distribution

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Normalized luminous intensity distribution / cumulative luminous flux distribution
text: When measured according to the test conditions specified in Annex 6, the normalized luminous intensity distribution and/or cumulative luminous flux distribution shall be within the limits given on the relevant data sheet of Annex 1.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Normalized luminous intensity distribution / cumulative luminous flux distribution
text: The measurement shall be made after ageing the LED replacement light source according to paragraph 3.4.1.1.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology)
title: Colour
text: Colour

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Colour
text: The colour of the light emitted by the LED replacement light sources shall be specified on the relevant data sheet. The definitions of the colour of the light emitted given in Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for type approval shall apply to this regulation.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Colour
text: The integral value of the chromaticity coordinates shall lie within the required chromaticity area; this shall be measured by the method specified in Annex 6.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Colour
text: In the case of LED replacement light sources emitting white light and for use in forward lighting devices, the colour shall be measured in the same directions as where the luminous intensity distribution is specified in the relevant data sheet, but only where the specified minimum luminous intensity is exceeding 50 cd/klm. The measured values shall lie within the required chromaticity area for white light.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology)
title: Electrical characteristics
text: Electrical characteristics

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Electrical characteristics
text: Electrical characteristics shall be tested at least at one sample and, in the case of a high-efficiency LED replacement light source, including and excluding the AE device(s), if any.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Electrical characteristics
text: The electrical current of the LED replacement light source shall be measured at ambient temperature of (23 ± 2) °C in still air after 1 minute and after 30 minutes of operation at test voltage. Measured values of the electrical current shall be within the limits as specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1. However, in the case of a high efficiency LED replacement light source, measured values of the electrical current shall be within the range(s) specified by the applicant according to paragraph 2.2.2.2.3.; if an AE device is prescribed by the applicant according to paragraph 2.2.2.2.2., measured values of the electrical current shall also be within the limits as specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1 with AE device(s) connected.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Electrical characteristics
text: The LED replacement light source shall comply with the technical requirements to an electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) as specified by Regulation No. 10 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for type approval.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Electrical characteristics
text: The LED replacement light source shall not emit light when energized for 2 milliseconds or shorter.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Electrical characteristics
text: Modulated light, emitted by the LED replacement light source when operated at a pulse-width modulated (PWM) voltage having an effective value, which is equal to the value of the prescribed test voltage, at frequencies of 100 Hz, 125 Hz, 150 Hz, 175 Hz and 200 Hz and all with a 90% duty cycle,13 shall not exhibit any frequency components lower than the applied PWM frequency. 13ON time as percentage of the total time of one PWM cycle.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology) > Electrical characteristics
text: If an objective luminous flux value for a dimming mode is specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1, this shall be tested.

heading: Technical requirements > LED replacement light sources (LED technology)
text: Cap temperature The cap temperature of the LED replacement light source shall not exceed the maximum cap temperature value indicated in the relevant datasheet of Annex 1. This shall be verified (except for high-efficiency types) by measurement according to the conditions specified in Annex 6.

title: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: Each package shall display the following information:

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: The trade name or mark of the applicant;

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: The rated voltage;

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: The designation of the LED replacement light source category and separated by a single character or line space "LEDr;

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: The approval code;

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: In the case of LED replacement light sources for which at least one of the conditions in paragraph 2.2.2.2.2. applies, the following requirements apply:

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: Each package shall also display the following symbol:14 14ISO 7000, symbol 1641

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: Each package shall contain instructions in an official language of the 1958 Agreement (i.e. English, French or Russian), supplemented by the corresponding text in the language of the country where it is sold:

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: Providing (a) website address(es) where the applicant shall publish up-to-date listing(s), for which the approval holder is responsible, of lighting and light signalling functions installed on vehicle models, specified by at least brand, type, model, and manufacturing period of the vehicle:

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: Stating that this LED replacement light source, including AE device(s), if listed, is suitable (or not) for fitment in these listed applications;

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: Providing information for these listed applications, necessary for installation and proper functioning of the LED replacement light source, aimed at the consumer, on the conditions that apply as stated by the applicant according paragraph 2.2.2.2.2.

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: Referring to professional maintenance or repair shops, if the applicability of the LED replacement light source is unclear;

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: Warning, clearly legible, that if this LED replacement light source is not used in accordance with the instructions with its package and with the instructions provided with the vehicle, this LED replacement light source may cause a fault in the vehicle’s electrical system and/or pose an operational and/or traffic safety risk;

heading: Requirements to the packaging of LED replacement light sources
text: The applicant shall provide the instructions, as referred to in paragraph 4.2.2., for displaying purposes at the point of sales without opening the package.

title: Conformity of production
text: Conformity of production

heading: Conformity of production
text: Light sources approved to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the inscriptions and technical requirements set forth in this Regulation, paragraph 3. and Annexes 1 and 3; in the case of filament light sources also Annex 4; in the case of LED replacement light sources also Annex 6.

heading: Conformity of production
text: In order to verify that the requirements of paragraph 4.1. are met, suitable controls of the production shall be carried out.

heading: Conformity of production
text: The holder of the approval shall in particular:

heading: Conformity of production
text: Ensure existence of procedures for the effective control of the quality of products;

heading: Conformity of production
text: Have access to the control equipment necessary for checking the conformity to each approved type;

heading: Conformity of production
text: Ensure that data of test results are recorded and that related documents shall remain available for a period to be determined in accordance with the Type Approval Authority,

heading: Conformity of production
text: Analyse the results of each type of test, applying criteria of Annex 7, in order to verify and ensure the stability of the product characteristics making allowance for variation of an industrial production;

heading: Conformity of production
text: Ensure that for each type of light source, at least the tests prescribed in Annex 7 to this Regulation are carried out;

heading: Conformity of production
text: Ensure that any collecting of samples giving evidence of non-conformity with the type of test considered shall give rise to another sampling and another test. All the necessary steps shall be taken to re-establish the conformity of the corresponding production.

heading: Conformity of production
text: Keep record of the information and listings, including the modifications and modification dates, published on its websites as described in paragraph 4.2.2.1.; this is the responsibility of the approval holder.

heading: Conformity of production
text: The Type Approval Authority which has granted type-approval may at any time verify the conformity control methods applicable to each production unit.

heading: Conformity of production
text: In every inspection, the test books and production survey records shall be presented to the visiting inspector.

heading: Conformity of production
text: The inspector may take samples at random which will be tested in the manufacturer's laboratory. The minimum number of samples may be determined according to the results of the manufacturer's own verification.

heading: Conformity of production
text: When the quality level appears unsatisfactory or when it seems necessary to verify the validity of the tests carried out in application of paragraph 4.4.2. above, the inspector shall select samples, to be sent to the Technical Service which has conducted the type approval tests.

heading: Conformity of production
text: The Type Approval Authority may carry out any tests prescribed in this Regulation. Where the Type Approval Authority decides to carry out spot checks, criteria of Annexes 8 and 9 to this Regulation shall be applied.

heading: Conformity of production
text: The normal frequency of inspection authorised by the Type Approval Authority shall be one every two years. In the case where negative results are recorded during one of these visits, the Type Approval Authority shall ensure that all necessary steps are taken to re-establish the conformity of production as rapidly as possible.

title: Penalties for non-conformity of production
text: Penalties for non-conformity of production

heading: Penalties for non-conformity of production
text: The approval granted in respect of a light source pursuant to this Regulation may be withdrawn if the requirements are not met or if a light source bearing the approval mark does not conform to the type approved.

heading: Penalties for non-conformity of production
text: If a Contracting Party to the Agreement applying this Regulation withdraws an approval it has previously granted, it shall forthwith so notify the other Contracting Parties applying this Regulation, by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 2 to this Regulation.

Production definitively discontinued If the holder of the approval completely ceases to manufacture a type of filament light source approved in accordance with this Regulation, he shall so inform the Type Approval Authority which has granted the approval. Upon receiving the relevant communication, that Type Approval Authority shall inform thereof the other Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 2 to this Regulation.

Names and addresses of the Technical Services responsible for conducting approval tests and of Type Approval Authorities The Parties to the 1958 Agreement which apply this Regulation shall communicate to the United Nations secretariat the names and addresses of the Technical Services responsible for conducting approval tests and of the Type Approval Authorities which grant approval and to which forms certifying approval or extension or refusal or withdrawal of approval, or production definitively discontinued issued in other countries, are to be sent.

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources
title: General
text: General

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources > General
text: Measurements shall be made on finished light sources. Filament light sources with secondary (outer) bulb acting as colour filter shall be handled as filament light source with primary bulb.

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources > General
text: Tests shall be made at an ambient temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C.

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources > General
text: Tests shall be made at test voltage(s) as specified in the relevant filament light source data sheet.

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources > General
text: Filament light sources shall be measured preferably in the normal operating position. In case of dual filament light sources the high wattage (major or driving beam) filament shall be operated only.

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources > General
text: Before starting a test, the stabilisation of the temperature of the filament light source shall be obtained by operating at test voltage for 10 minutes. In the case of filament light sources, for which more than one test voltage is specified, the relevant test voltage value shall be used for achieving stabilization.

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources
title: Colour
text: Colour

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources > Colour
text: Colour tests shall be made with a measuring system that determines CIE trichromatic co-ordinates of the received light with an accuracy of ±0.002.

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources > Colour
text: The trichromatic coordinates shall be measured with a colourimetric receiver integrating over a right circular cone subtending an angle of minimum 5° and maximum 15°, at the centre of the filament.

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources > Colour
text: Measuring directions (see the figure below).

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources > Colour
text: Initially, the receiver shall be positioned perpendicular to the filament light source axis and to the filament axis (or plane in case of a curved filament). After measurement the receiver shall be moved around the filament light source in bi-directional steps of about 30° until the area specified in paragraphs 2.3.2. or 2.3.3. is covered. In each position a measurement shall be made. However, no measurement shall be made when: (a) The centreline of the receiver coincides with the filament axis; or (b) The line of sight between the receiver and the filament is blocked by opaque (non-transmitting) parts of the light source, such as lead wires or a second filament, if any.

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources > Colour
text: For filament light sources used in headlamps, measurements shall be made in directions around the filament light source with the centreline of the receiver aperture located within an angle ±30°, from the plane perpendicular to the filament light source axis with the origin in the centre of the filament. In case of filament light sources with two filaments, the centre of the driving beam filament shall be taken.

heading: Annex 5 Checking the colour of filament light sources > Colour
text: For filament light sources used in light signalling devices, measurements shall be made in directions around the filament light source with exception of: (a) The area claimed or covered by the cap of the filament light source; and (b) The immediate transition area along the cap. In case of filament light sources with two filaments, the centre of the major filament shall be taken. In case of filament light source categories with a defined distortion-free angle, the measurement shall be done only within the defined angle. Figure illustrating the positions of colourimetric receiver

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources
text: LED replacement light sources shall be measured in still air at ambient temperature of (23 ± 2) °C, and at an additional ambient temperature if indicated in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources
title: Luminous flux
text: Luminous flux

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Luminous flux
text: A luminous flux measurement using an integrating method shall be made after 1 minute and after 30 minutes of operation.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Luminous flux
text: The luminous flux values, as measured after 30 minutes shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements. Additionally, unless otherwise specified on the data sheet (a) Either the luminous flux value measured after 30 minutes shall be in between 100 per cent and 80 per cent of the luminous flux value measured after 1 minute; or (b) The luminous flux value measured after 1 minute shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements, and in addition the luminous flux value measured after 30 minutes shall not deviate by more than ± 20 per cent from the luminous flux value measured after 1 minute.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Luminous flux
text:
Measurements have to be carried out at relevant test voltage and at the minimum and maximum values of the relevant voltage range. Unless specified more tightly on the data sheet the following deviation of the luminous flux at the tolerance interval limits shall not be exceeded.
|Rated voltage|Min voltage|Max voltage|
|---|---|---|
|6|6.0|7.0|
|12|12.0|14.0|
|24|24.0|28.0|
|Corresponding luminous flux tolerance*|±30%|±15%|
The maximum luminous flux deviation at the tolerance limits is calculated by using the measured flux at test voltage as reference. The luminous flux behaviour shall be substantially uniform within the voltage range specified in the table.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources
title: Normalized luminous intensity/ cumulative luminous flux
text: Normalized luminous intensity/ cumulative luminous flux

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Normalized luminous intensity/ cumulative luminous flux
text: The luminous intensity measurements shall be started after 30 minutes of operation.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Normalized luminous intensity/ cumulative luminous flux
text: Measurements have to be carried out at relevant test voltage.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Normalized luminous intensity/ cumulative luminous flux
text: Normalized luminous intensity of a test sample is calculated by dividing the luminous intensity distribution as measured under paragraph 2.1. and 2.2. of this annex by the luminous flux as determined under paragraph 1.2. of this annex.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources
text: Colour The colour of the light emitted as measured under the conditions as described paragraph in 1.1. of this annex shall be within the required colour boundaries.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources
title: Power consumption
text: Power consumption

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Power consumption
text: A power consumption measurement shall be made under the same conditions as described in paragraph 1.1. of this annex using the requirements of paragraph 3.4.1.3. of this Regulation.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Power consumption
text: Power consumption measurements shall be carried out at relevant test voltage and test voltage range, if specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Power consumption
text: Values obtained shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements of the relevant data sheet.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources
title: Electrical current
text: Electrical current

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Electrical current
text: An electrical current measurement shall be made under the same conditions as described in paragraph 1.1. of this annex using the requirements of paragraph 3.4.1.3. of this Regulation.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Electrical current
text: Electrical current measurements shall be carried out at relevant test voltage and test voltage range, if specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Electrical current
text: Values obtained shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements of the relevant data sheet.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources
title: Cap temperature
text: Cap temperature

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Cap temperature
text: A cap temperature measurement shall be made under the same conditions as described in paragraph 1.1. of this annex.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Cap temperature
text: Measurements shall be carried out at relevant test voltage.

heading: Annex 6 Method of measurement of electrical, photometrical and thermal characteristics of LED replacement light sources > Cap temperature
text: The cap temperature shall be determined at the location indicated in the light source category data sheet.

heading: Annex 7 Minimum requirements for quality control procedures by the manufacturer
text: General The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a photometric, geometrical, visual and electrical standpoint if the specified tolerances for production light sources in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1 and the relevant data sheet for the caps are met.

heading: Annex 7 Minimum requirements for quality control procedures by the manufacturer
text: Minimum requirements for verification of conformity by the manufacturer For each type of light source the manufacturer or the holder of the approval mark shall carry out tests, in accordance with the provisions of this Regulation, at appropriate intervals.

heading: Annex 7 Minimum requirements for quality control procedures by the manufacturer
text: Nature of tests Tests of conformity of these specifications shall cover their photometric, geometrical and optical characteristics.

heading: Annex 7 Minimum requirements for quality control procedures by the manufacturer
title: Methods used in tests
text: Methods used in tests

heading: Annex 7 Minimum requirements for quality control procedures by the manufacturer > Methods used in tests
text: Tests shall generally be carried out in accordance with the methods set out in this Regulation.

heading: Annex 7 Minimum requirements for quality control procedures by the manufacturer > Methods used in tests
text: The application of paragraph 2.2.1. requires regular calibration of test apparatus and its correlation with measurements made by a Type Approval Authority.

heading: Annex 7 Minimum requirements for quality control procedures by the manufacturer
text: Nature of sampling Samples of light sources shall be selected at random from the production of a uniform batch. A uniform batch means a set of light sources of the same type, defined according to the production methods of the manufacturer.

heading: Annex 7 Minimum requirements for quality control procedures by the manufacturer
text: Inspected and recorded characteristics The light sources shall be inspected and test results recorded following the grouping of characteristics as listed in Annex 7, Table 1.

heading: Annex 7 Minimum requirements for quality control procedures by the manufacturer
text: Criteria governing acceptability The manufacturer or the holder of approval is responsible for carrying out a statistical study of the test results in order to meet the specifications laid down for verification of conformity of production in paragraph 4.1. of this Regulation. Compliance shall be assured if the level of acceptable non-compliance per grouping of characteristics given in Table 1 of Annex 7 is not exceeded. This means that the number of light sources not complying with the requirement for any grouping of characteristics of any light source type does not exceed the qualifying limits in the relevant Tables 2, 3 or 4 of Annex 7. Note: Each individual light source requirement shall be considered as a characteristic.

heading: Annex 9 Minimum requirements for spot checks by the Type Approval Authority
text: General The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a photometric, geometrical, visual and electrical standpoint if the specified tolerances for production light sources in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1 and the relevant data sheet for the caps are met.

heading: Annex 9 Minimum requirements for spot checks by the Type Approval Authority
text: The conformity of mass-produced light sources shall not be contested if the results are in agreement with Annex 9 to this Regulation.

heading: Annex 9 Minimum requirements for spot checks by the Type Approval Authority
text: Conformity shall be contested and the manufacturer requested to make the production meet the requirements if the results are not in agreement with Annex 9 to this Regulation.

heading: Annex 9 Minimum requirements for spot checks by the Type Approval Authority
text: If paragraph 3 of this annex is applied, a further sample of 250 light sources, selected at random from a recent production run, shall be taken within two months.

heading: Annex 10 Compliance approved by spot check
text:
